mapper.select: select linkId from user_link where `from` = #{fromId} and `to` = #{toId};

SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN `from` = #{userId} THEN `to` -- 若 userId 是发起方，取接收方 ID WHEN `to` = #{userId} THEN `from` -- 若 userId 是接收方，取发起方 ID END AS targetId FROM user_link WHERE `from` = #{userId} OR `to` = #{userId}; -- 过滤出包含 userId 的记录
